# `<ptfkit/rawls2003.h>`

```c
#include <ptfkit/rawls2003.h>
```

Rawls et al. (2003), organic-carbon effects on soil water retention.

## Source

Rawls, W. J., Pachepsky, Y. A., Ritchie, J. C., Sobecki, T. M., & Bloodworth, H. (2003). Effect of soil organic carbon on soil water retention. Geoderma, 116(1-2), 61-76.

[DOI: 10.1016/S0016-7061(03)00094-6](https://doi.org/10.1016/S0016-7061(03)00094-6)

## Scope

**Territory:** United States

**Dataset:** Approximately 12,000 samples from the USDA National Soil Characterization database; equations were evaluated with NRCS pilot-study data.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/rawls2003.md)

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_tree` {#function-calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_tree}

Estimate volumetric water content at -33 kPa with the published regression tree.

```c
static inline double calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_tree(rawls2003_usda_texture_class soil_texture, double soil_organic_carbon);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `soil_texture` | in | USDA soil textural class used to traverse Figure 2. |
| `soil_organic_carbon` | in | Soil organic carbon content by mass. (% mass) |

#### Returns

Volumetric soil water content at -33 kPa. (cm³/cm³)

!!! note

    Figure 2 reports terminal means and within-node standard deviations in volume percent; public outputs divide the means by 100.

!!! note

    Every comparison is strict less-than, so equality follows the No branch. The cases cover every leaf and threshold.

!!! note

    A NaN organic-carbon input makes every less-than comparison false and follows the corresponding No branches; it is not propagated automatically.

### `calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_gmdh` {#function-calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_gmdh}

Estimate volumetric water content at -33 kPa with the published GMDH polynomial.

```c
static inline double calc_ptf_rawls2003_soc_theta33_gmdh(double soil_organic_carbon, double clay, double sand);
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Direction | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `soil_organic_carbon` | in | Soil organic carbon content by mass. (% mass) |
| `clay` | in | Clay content by mass. (% mass) |
| `sand` | in | Sand content by mass; clay plus sand must not exceed 100. (% mass) |

#### Returns

Volumetric soil water content at -33 kPa. (cm³/cm³)

!!! note

    The polynomial calculates volume percent; the public output divides the result by 100.

!!! warning

    Apply only within the source ranges and with clay plus sand no greater than 100%.
